lines: Good hands under pressure are rare. Yours were useful when the village needed them.
A tool proves itself under strain. So did you.
You were the right tool in a terrible moment.
When pressure came down, you did not warp.
The village needed more than sharp edges. It needed steady hands.
You made yourself useful where usefulness mattered most.
I saw the kind of work no bench can teach.
Good work leaves marks. Yours left people alive to notice.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
